titles.title: No. 2 – Special

description: In this abstract composition, several thin, white forms grouped around the center of the work curl downward like stamens surrounding the center of a flower. Thin white lines appear to support a small, shining black oval, raising it above the level of the stamens. An arch rendered in shades of black and gray frames the black shape.
